llm.summary: This is a coherent Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill for teachers, with disclosed classroom-data use and explicit lab-safety and teacher-review limits.

dimensions.detail: The declared platform abilities are proportionate: optional memory and file import/export support lesson planning, with fallback behavior when unavailable and controls for viewing, deletion, pause, sharing, and export.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown and JSON reference/schema files only; no executable scripts, package installation, remote retrieval, or tool-hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions align with the stated teacher-facing purpose, require teacher review, avoid student-facing substitution, and include crisis-handling, privacy, and experiment-safety boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can write lesson-plan entries to a class workspace, but the schema scope is limited and the skill says writes are generated as pending items that require teacher confirmation before storage.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is narrowly scoped to chemistry lesson-plan drafting, unit compression, and junior-to-senior-high transition planning; it explicitly does not provide executable lab procedures and routes detailed lab organization to a separate lab-guide skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese K12 chemistry teachers who want draft lesson plans, not for unsupervised student experiments. Teachers should still verify all lesson content, lab safety, local curriculum fit, and school procedures before classroom use.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The chemistry curriculum map lists required school experiments and safetyLevel labels as a planning reference; the main skill and lab-safety file repeatedly say experiments require teacher verification, school rules, PPE/safety controls, and that the skill must not output do-it-yourself dangerous procedures.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language terminology and locale assumptions are purpose-aligned: platform-conventions explicitly scopes the library to China-mainland Chinese K12 use and says other regions/languages require localization before deployment.
